function.description: Read a Uniswap v3 pool's live state: tokens, fee tier, current tick, price and liquidity. Give a pool address, OR token_a + token_b + fee to locate one. A pair with no pool yet is reported, not invented. Read-only. protocol='v4' reads a Pons graduated pool (token_a/token_b = 'native' + the Pons token).
function.name: defi_data_lp_pool_info

chain.description: Chain to read a Uniswap v3 pool on — the same address is a DIFFERENT token on a different chain, so name it deliberately. Readable: ethereum, base, robinhood, robinhood-testnet, arbitrum, polygon, optimism, solana.

fee.description: Fee tier in hundredths of a bip: 100, 500, 3000, 10000.

protocol.description: v3, or v4 for a Pons graduated pool (give token_a + token_b; the other side is 'native').
